rulings.decision: A 012A DEFECT, FIXED NOW AND FOLDED INTO THE R8 LANE. The runner is wrong. The backend pre-Ready reason set is unchanged. There is no new vocabulary: LAUNCH_UNKNOWN is replaced by two values the reviewed set and the child IPC enum already contain, TIMEOUT and INTERNAL_ERROR. The change is in studio-runner/src/run/launcher.ts, not runCoordinator.ts. It is runner-only and has no ordering dependency on the R8 edit.

verified: launcher.ts L477 awaits wait(ready || result || exited || violation, min(launchTimeoutMs, startDeadlineAt-now, runtimeDeadline-now)) and discards its boolean. wait returns false only when its timer expired.

L478-485: if !ready || violation || aborted, the launcher calls await stop() and throws ObservedPreReadyFailure(final?.errorCode ?? (aborted ? 'CANCELLED' : 'LAUNCH_UNKNOWN')). The coordinator (R8 L565-571) turns this into RUN_ERROR with errorMessage = that code.

With no child result and no abort, LAUNCH_UNKNOWN covers three different conditions: (a) the pre-Ready wait timed out, (b) the child exited before Ready or result, (c) an IPC protocol violation (the onMessage catch sets violation=true and kills the child).

LAUNCH_UNKNOWN is a runner-local string. It is not in the child IPC errorCode enum (replay-ipc.schema.json) and not in the backend's 10-reason pre-Ready set. requireObservedPreReadyFailure therefore returns 400 INVALID_REPORT, and the row waits for the RunningReaper (manifest reconcile or START_TIMEOUT).

Pitfall: performStop kills the child, so exited is true after await stop() on every path. The cause must be captured from wait's return value (or by snapshotting exited/violation) before stop() is called.

launch() calls launchObservedChild synchronously up to spawner.spawn (L333-343, L376-404). The pre-spawn demand(!aborted,'CANCELLED') at L401 therefore cannot be reached by a coordinator abort, which needs the event loop. Pre-spawn throws are synchronous validation, mkdir or scratch failures. They become coordinator 'browser-launch' / BROWSER_LAUNCH_FAILED, which is the residual OBS-006 design §2 explicitly leaves unadmitted. Not reopened here.

OBS-006 design §2 says the pre-Ready reasons cover the child's 'pre-Ready timers' (TIMEOUT) and 'INTERNAL_ERROR ... a failure inside its validated launch path'. The parent-observed launch-wait expiry is the same pre-Ready deadline condition. A child that dies, or breaks protocol, before Ready is a failure inside the launch path.
facts.whyNotBackend: The backend set is not wrong. It is the reviewed enumeration of child IPC reasons, and design §2 forbids blanket or arbitrary reasons. Adding LAUNCH_UNKNOWN would enlarge a security-reviewed set to admit a runner-invented string whose meanings already have in-set names.
facts.whyNow: Same seam, same 400-then-reaper strand as R8, and a one-expression change in the lane already open. Inference: under the host-sleep conditions of the c6-kill incident, the launcher's wait timer and the control tick can fire in either order on wake. If the wait timer wins, the run takes the ADJ-2 path even after R8 is fixed, so leaving ADJ-2 open would keep the cascade possible.

spec: Keep the boolean returned by the pre-Ready wait (e.g. const settled = await wait(...)), read before stop() is called.

Default reason when the child sent no result (final?.errorCode is still first and is never overwritten): aborted ? 'CANCELLED' : !settled ? 'TIMEOUT' : 'INTERNAL_ERROR'. Here !settled means the wait timer expired with no ready, result, exit or violation. settled with no ready/result means exit or violation. settled with ready plus violation also means violation.
Delete the LAUNCH_UNKNOWN literal from studio-runner/src entirely (single path, no alias, no compatibility mapping).

No change to wait bounds, launchTimeoutMs, startDeadlineAt or runtime deadline arithmetic, stopTimeoutMs, the kill path, recording observation, or the coordinator mapping (outer stays RUN_ERROR via 'run-fault' when R8's recorded flag is false).
exactChange.apiEffect: None to vocabulary. The outer code stays RUN_ERROR, so RunnerOutcomeCodes gives error_code NULL; 'TIMEOUT' and 'INTERNAL_ERROR' appear only in the bounded diagnostic. The API TIMEOUT error_code stays reserved to the post-Ready parent-enforced total runtime (outer TIMEOUT). The two remain distinguishable at the wire (outer code) and the API (error_code).

tests.change: 'fails the launch when the child never reports a start' (L365-370): expected code LAUNCH_UNKNOWN becomes TIMEOUT. 'fails the launch when the child exits before reporting a start' (L372-377): it becomes INTERNAL_ERROR. Keep the killed===1 assertion. Add a case where a malformed IPC message arrives before Ready: expect INTERNAL_ERROR and the child killed. Add a case where abort arrives while the child is silent: expect CANCELLED, which proves CANCELLED still takes precedence over TIMEOUT. Record old and new expectations by name in the lane ledger. Each is a value correction to the reviewed vocabulary, not a weakening.

Row 2 (L194-204): errorMessage LAUNCH_UNKNOWN becomes TIMEOUT if createChildDriver({ready:false}) keeps a silent live child until the launch wait expires, or INTERNAL_ERROR if it exits. The dev confirms which by reading the driver and records it. Keep result ERROR, outer RUN_ERROR, browserStartedAt null and the 'outer errorCode is not TIMEOUT' distinction assertion unchanged. Rename the title to drop LAUNCH_UNKNOWN.
Reuse the predicate-applying fake backend from R8.3 for one pre-Ready launch-wait-expiry case: the FINAL is accepted (no report.terminal_rejected), with errorMessage TIMEOUT.
Add LAUNCH_UNKNOWN to the refused-reason cases. This pins that the backend set does not grow. TIMEOUT and INTERNAL_ERROR are already accepted (AdmissionCasIT L414-428).

rulings.decision: CONFIRMED: deferred to STUDIO-OBS-009, as a new item under AC-11 (fault injection and recovery). AC-11 today covers mid-run revocation only after the browser starts ('cancels within one real control poll ... REVOKED_MID_RUN'). It does not cover a secret revoked while the run is ADMITTED but not yet started. Not a 012A change. R8 and ADJ-2 do not alter this path.

itemToRecord: Probe first: a failing joined IT. A secret-bearing observed run is held pre-Ready (initial-context pause seam), SecretRevocationSweep writes revoked_at while the ledger is ADMITTED, and the runner's recorded-revocation FINAL is observed. Today that FINAL gets a 409 and the row settles only via RunningReaper as ERROR/NULL or START_TIMEOUT, never AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED.

Then an architect ruling with security review at OBS-009 time. The likely options are: (a) admit ADMITTED+revoked_at on a narrowly checked pre-Ready terminal path, mapped to AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED (this touches the OBS-006 reviewed ledger edge); or (b) accept reaper settlement and document that pre-Ready revocation ends without a named cause. No option is pre-decided here.
Constraint carried: no deadline or reaper changes, and the one-vocabulary set unchanged (AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED already exists).
